# Bahdan Hal — Consulting & Engineering Portfolio

> Personal portfolio, backend consulting, infrastructure architecture, AI integrations, and contact lead ingestion by Bahdan Hal.

## Primary pages

- [About Bahdan Hal](https://bahdanhal.pl/): backend work, infrastructure architecture, AI integrations, and case studies
- [Services & Experience](https://bahdanhal.pl/#services): backend engineering, production support, system integrations, and MCP development
- [Contact & Consultation](https://bahdanhal.pl/#consultation): direct consultation inquiries and project scope discussion

## Ecosystem applications

- [StackHal](https://stackhal.com/): developer tools and web infrastructure diagnostics
- [IleZa](https://ileza.pl/): Polish used tech price radar and salary calculator

## Data access

- Public read-only MCP endpoint: `https://bahdanhal.pl/mcp`
- Public MCP tools: `get_portfolio_overview`, `submit_contact_lead`.
- No account or API key is required for public tools.
